excluded_categories: Unlisted pytest temporary directories and SQLite databases
scope: Completed 14-command development history and bounded independent source review only.
redaction_policy: Only exact context-validated synthetic SessionIdentity/CSRF value spans, then parameterized home and pytest paths; no outcome rewritten.
aggregate_rule: SHA256 canonical UTF-8 JSON of files/generated_files, sort_keys=True,separators comma/colon,ensure_ascii=False
path_rules: Raw .patch/.diff names become .patch.log/.diff.log; alias mapping is authoritative.
